WITH h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
ex AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
grp AS (SELECT member_id, 'hold' g FROM h UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'targeted' FROM ex),
s AS (SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_spend, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nonstaff, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff_lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT m.member_id, sum(rl.refund_net) refunds FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g, count(*) n, sum(coalesce(gross_spend,0))/count(*) avg_all, sum(coalesce(nonstaff,0))/count(*) avg_nonstaff, sum(coalesce(nonstaff,0)-coalesce(refunds,0))/count(*) avg_nonstaff_net, sum(coalesce(staff_lines,0)) staff_lines, count(s.member_id) buyers
FROM grp LEFT JOIN s USING(member_id) LEFT JOIN r USING(member_id) GROUP BY g

WITH r AS (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) rt, sum(net_sales) n, sum(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-11-28' GROUP BY 1),
f AS (SELECT sale_date, sum(net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) nonstaff, sum(CASE WHEN channel_id=1 AND NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900) THEN net_amount END) st_nonstaff, sum(CASE WHEN channel_id=1 AND store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900) THEN net_amount END) st_all, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel_id=1 THEN receipt_id END) rcpts FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date = DATE '2025-11-28' GROUP BY 1),
rt AS (SELECT sum(refund_net) x FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date=DATE '2025-11-28')
SELECT * FROM r, f, rt

WITH grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'holdout' AS grp FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
), spend AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1
), refunds AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m USING (member_key) JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  GROUP BY 1
), per_member AS (
  SELECT g.grp, g.member_id, coalesce(s.amt,0) - coalesce(r.amt,0) AS net_spend
  FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend s USING (member_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (member_id)
), avgs AS (SELECT grp, count(*) n, avg(net_spend) a FROM per_member GROUP BY grp)
SELECT 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign, 15 AS campaign_id,
  round(max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN a END),2) AS avg_spend_targeted,
  round(max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN a END),2) AS avg_spend_holdout,
  round(max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN a END) - max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN a END),2) AS uplift_eur,
  max(CASE WHEN grp='targeted' THEN n END) n_t, max(CASE WHEN grp='holdout' THEN n END) n_h
FROM avgs
